title: Fewest Boxes to Fill the Order
statement:
A warehouse has `n` boxes, and box `i` holds `c_i` items. An order asks for at least `S` items in total. You may take whole boxes only. Find the smallest number of boxes whose contents add up to at least `S`.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `S`. The second line contains `n` integers `c_i`.

## Output
Print the smallest number of boxes that together hold at least `S` items. If even all boxes together hold fewer than `S`, print `-1`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `1 <= c_i <= 10^9`
- `1 <= S <= 10^15`
